$Comment: Ice King, flying prototype: a Variant of vanilla Template_Flying_Aggressive (as Spirit_Frost) that keeps 4-8 blocks over the ground in combat and fires the ice ray. Later it becomes the air phase, switched with the ground role by the EncounterManager (ChangeTargetRole). Placeholder appearance: it has no Fly animations. 2026-10-21 (playtest: he hovered over the player's head): higher floor (MotionFlyMinHeightAboveGround), and when he is far the Seek stops farther than his flying height (CombatSeekStopDistance), so he no longer comes to rest right above the player; close by, his combat component circles around the player. 2026-10-21 (playtest: he loses focus and flies off): CombatBehaviorDistance 60 (template default 30). Past it, or without line of sight, Template_Flying_Aggressive drops from combat to .Chase (Soft_Leash + Intelligent_Chase), and a lost target sends him to Search, wandering 20-30 s. 2026-10-21 (playtest: no air death / ground crash animation, the pigeon has both): DeathAnimationTime 6 (template default 2). The king inherits DeathFly (falling) and DeathFlyImpact (crash) from the vanilla Player model, like the Pigeon, but his corpse was removed 2 s after death, still in the air from 14-20 blocks up, so neither the fall nor the crash on landing showed. 2026-10-21: AlertedTime [0.2, 0.2] (template default 2 s), so after a role change he reaches combat at once and his combat component plays PhaseChange. 2026-10-21 (playtest: in phase 2 he flies too low and too close): MotionFlyMinHeightAboveGround 12 (was 9), MaxHeight 26 (22), combat altitude 16-22 (14-20), Seek stop/slowdown 22/26 (18/22); the circle radius in Component_AT_Ice_King_Air_Combat is 18 (12).
